name: torr
description: Build workouts into your Torr account and review your training history and lift progress.

interface.longDescription:
Torr is a strength training app. Connect it here and ChatGPT can build your workouts straight into your Torr account - no copying, no retyping.

Ask for a weekly program ("4 days, push/pull/legs, I only have dumbbells") or a single session for today, and ChatGPT picks real exercises from Torr's catalog, sets your sets, reps and rest, and saves the plan. It shows up in the Torr app ready to train, with exercise demos, a rest timer and set logging.

ChatGPT can also look at how you have been training: sessions and volume per week, your streak, and whether a lift is improving, so it can tell you when it is time to change the program.

What it can see: your training profile (goal, level, training days, equipment), your training history and exercise progress. What it cannot see: your email, password, payment details, body measurements or nutrition profile. It only creates workouts - it never deletes anything you or a coach built.

Requires a Torr account (iPhone, App Store).
defaultPrompt: Build me a 4-day push/pull/legs plan in Torr. I train at a gym.
Make a 30-minute dumbbell-only workout for today and save it to Torr.
How has my bench press progressed over the last 3 months?

positive.prompt: What does my Torr training profile say?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes goal, level, training days per week and available equipment.

positive.prompt: Build me a 3-day full body plan for the gym and save it to Torr.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a 3-day workout in Torr using catalog exercises; it appears in the Workouts tab and on the app home.

positive.prompt: Make a 20-minute bodyweight workout for today in Torr.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates one workout with no weekday assigned, ready to start in the app.

positive.prompt: How consistent have I been training lately?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports sessions and volume per week, the last workout and the current streak.
Shows the best set per session and an estimated 1RM trend, labeled as an estimate.

negative.description: Medical diagnosis is not a Torr function; should suggest seeing a doctor without calling tools.
negative.prompt: I have chest pain when I lift, what is wrong with me?

negative.description: Torr does not sell or buy anything through ChatGPT; should say it cannot make purchases.
negative.prompt: Order a tub of whey protein for me.

negative.description: There is no delete tool; should explain that deleting is done in the Torr app.
negative.prompt: Delete all my workouts in Torr.

review.commerce_description: Torr does not sell products or process payments through ChatGPT.

publication.release_notes: Available in every country where ChatGPT is available (no longer US-only).
